title: Dovetailing: how sections, loops and hooks interlock
doc: Transitions as data: gate atoms with a point param say where (pickup, rise, hit, tail), mini atoms say how (masks for handoffs, equal-power fade tables), move racks say what happens (fade, throw, hold, duck). The hooks split rule does the rest: a note that starts before a gate boundary rings through it, so tails overlap by construction.

atomsIngredient.title: Dovetail atoms
atomsIngredient.doc: glyphcore/phonk dovetail atoms (dt.): gate atoms with a point param for pickups, rises, hits and tails; masks for call-and-response handoffs; equal-power fade tables; a turnaround. Import with atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/phonk:atoms-dovetail").

fadeOut.doc: equal-power fade-out over one cycle (velocity table dt.xfadeOut); bind it for the transition bar

throw.doc: delay throw: the gated notes go to a dotted-8th delay that rings into the next section

tailHold.doc: long release so the last notes of a section overlap the next one; for a reverb tail send to a scoped return (ret("verb").hpf(200)), so the low end stays mono

duckUnder.doc: duck the bed under the impact (needs a tap named hit on the impact lane)

target.skip: needs a hit tap in the program; covered by the Syntax example

pickup.doc: the last beat before a point: fills, 808 pickups, throws

rise.doc: a riser window that ends exactly on the point

hit.doc: the bar that starts on the point: impact, downlifter, duck

tail.doc: where an outgoing part may keep ringing after the point

callMask.doc: call: first half of each bar

answerMask.doc: response: second half of each bar

turnaround.doc: three bars of the loop, then a turnaround bar that leads back in

recipes.title: Pickup fill into the next section
recipes.intent: Three bars of beat; in the fourth, a clap roll on beat 4 leads into the downbeat.
recipes.notes: With hooks the fill is gated by dt.pickup({ at: "5b" }) (the last beat before bar 5) on a slot whose else is silence.

recipes.title: 808 pickup
recipes.intent: The 808 plays a two-note pickup in the last beat of every 4th bar, so the next downbeat feels caught.

recipes.title: Overlapping tail
recipes.intent: The pad section ends after bar 2 but its release and room ring into bar 3, where the keys enter: no hole between sections.
recipes.notes: The hooks split rule gives the same overlap: a note that starts before a gate boundary rings through it.

recipes.title: Call and response handoff
recipes.intent: The lead calls in the first half of each bar, the keys answer in the second: two parts share one space.

recipes.title: Equal-power crossfade between sections
recipes.intent: Over bar 4 the pad fades out on a cos table while the keys fade in on a sin table: constant loudness through the change.

recipes.title: Riser, impact, downlifter
recipes.intent: A two-bar riser ends exactly on the downbeat, the impact lands on the one, the downlifter falls after it.
recipes.notes: With hooks: dt.rise({ at: "5b", len: 2 }), dt.hit({ at: "5b" }).

recipes.title: Ducked transition
recipes.intent: The pad bed ducks under the impact on the one and breathes back over a bar.

recipes.title: Delay throw
recipes.intent: The last hit of every 4th bar is thrown into a dotted-8th delay that rings into the next bar.

recipes.title: Turnaround bar
recipes.intent: Three bars of the loop, then a turnaround bar on the V that pulls back into bar 1.

syntax.title: Pickup fill on a gate atom (dt.pickup)
syntax.explain: the fill slot is silent except in the last beat before bar 5 (quant: 0 keeps the sub-bar gate exact)
syntax.code:
setcpm(90/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/phonk:atoms-hiphop"); atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/phonk:atoms-dovetail")
hooks.bind("kick", "bbKick"); hooks.bind("snare", "clap")
hooks.bind("fill", "clap", atoms.dt.pickup({ at: "5b" }))
kick: s(atoms.hh.boomKick).use("kick")
snare: s(atoms.hh.boomSnare).use("snare")
fill: s("x*16").use("fill", { else: "silence", quant: 0 }).velocity("[.4 .6 .8 1]*4")

syntax.title: Crossfade two sections with gated fade racks
syntax.explain: fadeOut and fadeIn bound for bar 4 only; lanes muted outside their section
syntax.code:
setcpm(90/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/phonk:atoms-hiphop")
hooks.bind("pad", "airPad"); hooks.bind("keys", "rhodes")
hooks.bind("pad", "fadeOut", "4b..5b"); hooks.bind("keys", "fadeIn", "4b..5b")
pad: note(atoms.hh.cloudChords).use("pad").tags("a")
keys: note("[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]*4").use("keys").tags("b")
tagged("a").mute("@5b")
tagged("b").mute("<4b")

syntax.title: Riser into the drop, impact on the one, bed ducked under it
syntax.explain: dt.rise and dt.hit place the fx; duckUnder wires the pad gain to the impact's envelope tap
syntax.code:
setcpm(90/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/phonk:atoms-hiphop"); atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/phonk:atoms-dovetail")
hooks.bind("rise", "riser", atoms.dt.rise({ at: "5b", len: 2 })); hooks.bind("hit", "impact", atoms.dt.hit({ at: "5b" }))
hooks.bind("pad", "airPad"); hooks.bind("duck", "duckUnder(0.8)")
rise: s("x/2").use("rise", { else: "silence" })
hit: s("x").use("hit", { else: "silence" }).hpf(35).tap("hit", { export: true })
pad: note(atoms.hh.cloudChords).use("pad").use("duck")

syntax.title: Call and response with mask atoms
syntax.explain: dt.callMask and dt.answerMask split each bar between two parts
